pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions on the flank and lower neck exhibit polygonal geometry with relatively sharp pixel-level edge gradients. The spatial area of individual patches is significantly larger on the central flank than on the lower neck, where they appear more compressed and rounded.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative space forms a continuous topological mesh of thin pathways. Junction nodes are primarily characterized by tri-directional intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively uniform across the visible mid-section of the torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the neck ridge shows a jagged 1D silhouette with low-amplitude and high-frequency pixel projections against the background.
